_readme: Each entry maps a PDF in the drop folder (~/Downloads/COURSERA CREDENTIALS) to its public details. Every field comes from the certificate itself. Run `npm run credentials:sync` (it also runs on deploy) to copy the PDFs into public/credentials/.
